comment: Queue of real, documented tech incidents for the 'how it actually broke' series. generate_script.py pops the first status:pending topic, generates a script, and flips it to status:done. Add more topics anytime — these are proven-interesting (real stakes, real consequences), which is the whole point of the angle: not generic AI definitions, real stories.
